name: Fleet Line Item 7
definition: Supplies additional transaction information for fleet transactions.

Fuel.name: Fuel
Fuel.definition: Indicates whether or not the line item represents a fuel or non-fuel product or service.||True = Fuel item|False = Non-fuel item

ServiceType.name: Service Type
ServiceType.definition: Type of service received at the acceptor location.

FuelBrandCode.name: Fuel Brand Code
FuelBrandCode.definition: Code that identifies the brand of the fuel purchased.

ProductCode.name: Product Code
ProductCode.definition: Product code of fleet product or service being purchased.

ProductCategory.name: Product Category
ProductCategory.definition: Contains a code that identifies a category of fleet products or services.

ProductQualifier.name: Product Qualifier
ProductQualifier.definition: Contains a code that identifies the product qualifier of the fleet product or service.

ProductCodeAssigner.name: Product Code Assigner
ProductCodeAssigner.definition: Contains a code that identifies the product code assigner.

UnitPriceTax.name: Unit Price Tax
UnitPriceTax.definition: Indicates whether or not tax is included in unit price.||True: includes tax |False: does not include tax.

UnitPrice.name: Unit Price
UnitPrice.definition: Unit price of the fleet line item.

UnitOfMeasure.name: Unit Of Measure
UnitOfMeasure.definition: Unit of measure of the item purchased. P000-P999 reserved for private use, N000-N999 reserved for national use.

PercentageDiscountRate.name: Percentage Discount Rate
PercentageDiscountRate.definition: Contains the discount rate in retail minus discount method.

PerUnitDiscountRate.name: Per Unit Discount Rate
PerUnitDiscountRate.definition: Contains unit discount per unit amount in retail minus discount model.

CostPlusUnitDiscount.name: Cost Plus Unit Discount
CostPlusUnitDiscount.definition: Contains the unit discount per unite amount in cost plus discount method.

CostPlusUnitDiscountSign.name: Cost Plus Unit Discount Sign
CostPlusUnitDiscountSign.definition: Contain the sign of cost plus unite discount.

CostPlusUnitPrice.name: Cost Plus Unit Price
CostPlusUnitPrice.definition: Contains unit price in cost plus discount method.

TotalTimePluggedIn.name: Total Time Plugged In
TotalTimePluggedIn.definition: Contains the total time the vehicle was plugged in.

TotalTimeCharging.name: Total Time Charging
TotalTimeCharging.definition: Contain the actual total time taken to charge the vehicle.

ChargingStartTime.name: Charging Start Time
ChargingStartTime.definition: Contains the start time of the charge.

ChargingCompletionTime.name: Charging Completion Time
ChargingCompletionTime.definition: Contains the completion time of the charge.

DiscountAmount.name: Discount Amount
DiscountAmount.definition: Contains the discount amount applied to the fleet transaction (includes coupons).

NonTaxable.name: Non Taxable
NonTaxable.definition: Indicates whether or not amount of fleet purchase is taxable.

Tax.name: Tax
Tax.definition: Taxes related to the products or services.

NetAmount.name: Net Amount
NetAmount.definition: Contains net line item, less any taxes exempted or discounts.
